```{r}
prefix = "fraglen"
max_frag_len = 500
options =   paste0(
    "--numberOfProcessors 32 ", 
    "--maxFragmentLength ", max_frag_len, " ", 
    "--binSize 10000 ", 
    "--distanceBetweenBins 1000000 "
  )
if (!exists("COMPUTEFRAGESIZE")) {COMPUTEFRAGESIZE = FALSE}
```



```{r samples, child="samples.Rmd"}
```



# Fragment Size Distribution


```{r bamPEFragmentSize, eval=COMPUTEFRAGESIZE}
dir.create(prefix, showWarnings=FALSE)

foo = lapply(rownames(e), function(gsm) {
  bam_file = e[gsm,]$bam
  cmd = "bamPEFragmentSize"
  args = paste0(
    "-b ", bam_file, " ", 
    "-o ", prefix, "/", gsm, ".png ", 
    "--outRawFragmentLengths ", prefix, "/", gsm, ".txt ", 
    options
  )
  print(paste(cmd, args))
  system2(cmd, args)
})
```

## One histogram for all sample

```{r}
convs = sapply(rownames(e), function(gsm) {
  h = mread.table(paste0(prefix, "/", gsm, ".txt"), header=TRUE)
  conv = stats::ksmooth(h[,1], h[,2]/sum(h[,2]), "normal", bandwidth=5)
  conv
})

ylim = c(0, max(unlist(convs[2,]), na.rm=TRUE))
layout(1, respect=TRUE)
plot(0, 0, col=0, ylab="", xlab="", ylim=ylim, xlim=c(0,max_frag_len), main="")  
abline(v=c(75, 150, 300, 450), lty=3, col="grey")    
for (gsm in rownames(e)) {
  lines(convs[,gsm], col=adjustcolor(1, alpha.f=.5), lty=1, lwd=1)
}

```


## One histogram per sample

```{r hists}
layout(matrix(1:6, 2, byrow=TRUE), respect=TRUE)
for (gsm in rownames(e)) {
  print(gsm)
  plot(0, 0, col=0, ylab="", xlab="", ylim=ylim, xlim=c(0,max_frag_len), main=gsm)  
  abline(v=c(75, 150, 300, 450), lty=3, col="grey")    
  h = mread.table(paste0(prefix, "/", gsm, ".txt"), header=TRUE)
  lines(h[,1], h[,2]/sum(h[,2]), col=adjustcolor(2, alpha.f=.5), lty=1, lwd=1)
  conv = convs[,gsm]
  lines(conv, col=adjustcolor(1, alpha.f=.5), lty=1, lwd=1)
}
```


# PCA



```{r pca}
hs = lapply(rownames(e), function(gsm) {
  h = mread.table(paste0(prefix, "/", gsm, ".txt"), header=TRUE)
  h[,1]
})

tmp = sort(unique(unlist(hs)))
tmp = tmp[tmp<=max_frag_len]
sizes = paste0("sz", tmp)

data = matrix(0, nrow=length(rownames(e)), ncol=length(sizes))


rownames(data) = rownames(e)
colnames(data) = sizes
head(data[,1:10])

for (gsm in rownames(e)) {
  print(gsm)
  h = mread.table(paste0(prefix, "/", gsm, ".txt"), header=TRUE)
  h = h[h[,1] <= max_frag_len,]
  data[gsm, paste0("sz",h[,1])] = h[,2]  
}
head(data[,1:10])

layout(1, respect=TRUE)
image(t(data))

pca = prcomp(data, scale=FALSE)
v = pca$sdev * pca$sdev
p = v / sum(v) * 100

layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
# layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
barplot(p, ylab="% of variance explained", xlab="components")
for (i in 1:5) {
  j = i+1
  plot(
    pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j],
    xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
    ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
    col=1,
    pch=16
  )
}
layout(1, respect=TRUE)
i=1 ; j = i+1
plot(
  pca$x[,1], pca$x[,j],
  xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
  ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
  col=adjustcolor(1, alpha.f=0.5),
  pch=16
)
text(pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j], rownames(pca$x))
layout(1, respect=TRUE)
image(t(data[rownames(pca$x)[order(pca$x[,1])], ]))


# --- MCLUST sur les scores PCA ---
library(mclust)
mc = mclust::Mclust(pca$x[,1:2], G=2)
cl = mc$classification
e$fraglenclust = as.factor(paste0("c", cl[rownames(e)]))
saveRDS(e$fraglenclust, "e_fraglenclust.rds")
if (!exists("factoi")) {factoi = c()}
factoi = unique(c("fraglenclust", factoi))

if (exists("factoi")) {
  fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
  if (length(fois)>0) {
    for (foi in fois) {
      layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
      # layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
      barplot(p, ylab="% of variance explained", xlab="components")
      cols = as.numeric(e[rownames(pca$x),foi])
      legend("topright", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi, bty="n")
      for (i in 1:5) {
        j = i+1
        plot(
          pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j],
          xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
          ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
          col=cols,
          pch=16
        )
      }
    }
  }
}




```
